name: netwave
description: Network scattering-parameter math for node + browser (single package, exports conditions)

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.mjs -o dist --format esm && napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.cjs -o dist --format commonjs && pnpm build:shells
scripts.build:native:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.mjs -o dist --format esm && napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --js index.node.generated.cjs -o dist --format commonjs && pnpm build:shells
scripts.build:wasm: cross-env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=../target-wasm wasm-pack build wasm --target web --out-dir ../dist/wasm-web
scripts.test: pnpm test:native && pnpm test:wasm && pnpm test:browser
